rows.text: reads byte `+0x3A` of `rcx`; when its bit 0 is clear, stores 1 to byte `+0x3B` and writes byte `+0x3A` back with bit 0 set (OR 1); when bit 0 is already set it changes nothing

walks the list headed by qword `02EC3D60` through qword `+0x28` of each node until a null link (returning at once when the head is null), and for every node whose qword `+0x10` is non-null clears bit `0x4` of word `+0x368` of that object (AND `0xFFFB`)

walks up to 36 (`0x24`) records of stride `0x18` whose qword field starts at `02EBEC08`, stopping at the first record whose dword 8 bytes before that qword is 0; for each record whose qword is non-null and whose pointee's word `+0x368` has bit `0x4` set, writes that word back with the bit cleared (AND `0xFFFB`)
returns dword `+0xC8` of qword `02B47730` when that pointer is non-null and bit `0x4` of its byte `+0xC0` is set; returns 0 when the pointer is null or the bit is clear
returns 1 when qword `02B47730` is non-null, bit `0x4` of its byte `+0xC0` is set and its dword `+0xC8` is non-zero (`setne`); returns 0 otherwise
